title: RentGuard Renters Policy Restart Credit — Premium Accounting Calculation
content:
The restart credit owed on a RentGuard Renters Policy when its multi-policy discount restarts is worked out in this order.

**(a) Annual premium without discounts.** The current annual premium of the renters policy divided by one less the tier's autopay discount percentage divided by 100 when the billing plan is the monthly EFT plan, and taken as it stands on any other plan, rounded half-up to the cent. It is taken from the current annual premium in that way and is not rebuilt from the contents, liability and co-insured charges; a current annual premium held at the tier's minimum annual premium is treated the same way.

**(b) Discount percentages after the restart.** The tier's autopay discount percentage when the billing plan is the monthly EFT plan, together with the tier's multi-policy discount percentage. Any restart points are added to the discount percentages after the restart, and any restart points subtracted are taken off them.

**(c) Annual premium after the restart.** The annual premium without discounts reduced by the discount percentages after the restart, rounded half-up to the cent and never less than the tier's minimum annual premium. It is restated as the policy's annual premium.

**(d) Annual reduction.** The current annual premium less the annual premium after the restart.

**(e) Days credited for the restart.** The calendar days from the effective date of the new qualifying policy — the Larkspur Valuables Floater or Larkspur Personal Umbrella Policy of the customer that took effect and is in force — to the expiration date of the renters term.

**(f) Share of the year credited for the restart.** The days credited for the restart divided by the calendar days in the renters term.

**(g) Restart credit.** The annual reduction multiplied by the share of the year credited for the restart, rounded half-up to the cent once, on the final figure only.

A restart credit below the tier's minimum midterm premium change is not posted.

### Hypothetical worked example

Hypothetical inputs only: annual plan; current annual premium 200.00 USD; tier multi-policy discount percentage 5; tier minimum annual premium 118.00 USD; minimum midterm premium change 2.00 USD; renters term of 365 calendar days; 146 calendar days from the new qualifying policy's effective date to the renters expiration date.

| Quantity | Working | Figure |
|---|---|---|
| Annual premium without discounts | taken as it stands on the annual plan | 200.00 |
| Discount percentages after the restart | multi-policy percentage only | 5 |
| Annual premium after the restart | 200.00 reduced by 5 percent, above the minimum | 190.00 |
| Annual reduction | 200.00 less 190.00 | 10.00 |
| Share of the year | 146 divided by 365 | 0.4 |
| Restart credit | 10.00 multiplied by 0.4, rounded once | 4.00 |

The 4.00 USD credit is at or above 2.00 USD and is posted.
